visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Old Values Stay at the End
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The result for 4 0 5 0 0 6 should be 4 5 6 0 0 0, but the program prints 4 5 6 0 0 6.

solution.explanation: Copying the non-zero values forward overwrites the front of the array but leaves the old values behind them. The positions from pos to the end must be set to 0 explicitly.
